description: One-shot registry/shopping-list builder: create a registry and fill from ASINs/keywords/queries. Best tool for agents building a full baby list. Returns ownerUrl + shopUrl + editToken. Requires marketplace + locale.

locale.description: End-user locale, e.g. en, en-US, sv-SE, de-DE

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, us, se

name: create_and_fill_registry
